column1: # Role registry. Tab-separated. One of the two files allowed to name concrete
# models (the other is docs/MODELS.md).
# model_key identifies the weights. ctx and slots are per load.
# weights is the directory under ~/.hearth/models that oMLX serves.
# scripts/pin-digests.sh hashes that directory (D4).
# role
# backend: omlx for a local role, or an explicit cloud backend (gemini).
# draft is "-" . The column remains so the columns keep their positions.
# load: resident → scripts/omlx.sh up keeps it loaded. beside → loaded only by
# ask-deep or scripts/demand-load.sh, next to the resident (ADR 0020, 0028).
# swap → the same, but it unloads the resident first and restores it after
# (ADR 0031). Demand roles are skipped by healthcheck and bench.
# edit → kept loaded like resident, but serves only /v1/completions for
# editor edit prediction (ADR 0033). Never a chat or agent model.
# min_ram: tiers (ADR 0032). A host uses, per role, the row with the largest
# min_ram (GB of RAM) at or below its own. "-" on cloud rows. A tier gets a
# row only after it is benched on that hardware; candidates live in MODELS.md.
# No local-main row fits under 48 GB, so a smaller host fails loudly.
local-main
local-deep
local-edit
cloud-cheap
